features.title: The core principles
features.description: These convictions shape every feature — so the team stays in sync and the room stays in worship.

singleSource.title: Single Source of Truth
description: Do you know that pain of different people having different sheets? If you want to change the set you have to run to the AV team and ping pong slides?

With Worship Viewer you have a way to solve that. One of the core principles is called “Single Source of Truth”. What does this mean? It means at one place there is one instance of your sheet or set defined.
This then can be viewed by all your team members in different forms (sheets, slides, etc.) and different kinds of devices. You update it once, it’s rolled out everywhere.

preparedYetFree.title: Prepared yet Free
description: Do you know the pain of achieving professionally through inflexibility? That you either plan everything to the smallest detail and everyone knows what he has to do when, or that everything is completely free?

There is a lot of good professional software out there, that helps you do your worship session in a professional manner, but often you lose your flexibility to be spontaneous, to be led by the spirit.
With Worship Viewer you have a way to solve that. The app lets you plan everything yet still to break out at every point to give you the flexibility you need without losing professionality.

allForHisGlory.title: All for His Glory
description: “For from him and through him and for him are all things. To him be the glory forever! Amen.” — Romans 11:36
That holds true for everything and therefore as well for this app. Its purpose is not to make profit, not to be a cool tool, not to make good music. Its only purpose is to glorify God.
It’s His project and using it as well as developing it should be in worship to the one and only God, the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.
